title: Karin Kiho: one-sentence intro with hand-drawn circles round the skills
note: The homepage opens with one centred sentence in Google Sans Flex 300 at about 44px: 'I'm a multidisciplinary designer with 5+ years of experience, working across UI/UX for digital products, graphic design, front-end development, and interactive experiences.' Each skill is circled or underlined in a different hand-drawn SVG stroke (pink, blue, green, yellow wave). The nav sits in brackets '(Works)' with a little eye logo. Worth reusing: say who you are in one plain sentence, then let a hand-made mark add the personality. It reads instantly and doesn't look generated.
